info.title: Q_Profile_Entry
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

description.description: Used for documentation of these queue configuration parameters.

hw_default.description: When true, this row contains the hardware default queue profile parameters for this queue.

local_priorities.description: This essential parameter specifies one or more local-priority(s) that are assigned to this queue.  Packets' local-priority meta-data is initially assigned by the port's QoS Trust Mode  (see [Port](#/Port) qos_config).  If missing, the queue is not used.

queue_number.description:
Reference Resource: [Q_Profile_Entry](#/Q_Profile_Entry)
Configuration parameters for individual queues. Queues are numbered in *priority order*, with zero being the lowest priority. A queue-profile must contain 1 to 8 queues.

parameters.name: Q_Profile.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Q_Profile](#/Q_Profile)
There must be a user-defined name of the queue profile.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
